definitions.short: a knife or razor (as making bare); also a scabbard (as being bare , i.e. empty)
definitions.full: H8593. taar תַּ֫עַר noun masculine Psa 52:4 and ( Isa 7:20 ) feminine razor, sheath ; — 1. a. razor , absolute בְּת ׳יְגַלַּח Isa 7:20 (figurative); subject of עַלרֿאֹשׁ יַעֲבֹר לֹא Num 6:5 , object of עַלֿ הֶעֱבִיר 8:7 (P), compare construct ׳ת הַגַּלָּבִים Ezek 5:1 ; absolute ׳כְּת מְלֻטָּשׁ Psa 52:4 (simile of tongue). b. construct ׳ת הַסֹּפֵר Jer 36:23 = penknife . 2 sheath , always suffix of sword: בְּתַעְרָהּ 2Sam 20:8 ; of drawing sword, מִתּ ׳שָׁלַף 1Sam 17:51 , מִתּ ׳הוֺצִיא Ezek 21:8 ; 21:10 , מִתּ ׳תֵּצֵא 21:9 ; of sheathing, אֶלתַּֿרְעֵךְ הֵאָֽסְפִי Jer 47:6 ; אֶלתַּֿעְרָהּ הָשַׁב Ezekiel 21:35.
